COLLEGES.  
महोदय / महोदया, 
In response to the advertisement dated 19.05.2026, you are requested to report for submission 
and verification of documents on the scheduled date and time as under: - 
 
a Date of Interview  
 
b ररपोर्म करिे का सर्य / 
Reporting time 9:30 AM 
 
 
c

of Interview. Directorate (Medical) Delhi, 3 rd Floor, ESIC 
Dispensary-cum-Diagnostic Centre Complex, Mayur 
Vihar Phase-I, New Delhi-110091. 
1. Subsequent to submission and verification of documents  if it is found that you are fulfilling the eligibility 
conditions for the post applied for, you shall be allowed to appear for the Interview for the aforesaid post 
( purely on Provisional Basis). The candidate being allowed to appear in the Interview will not mean 
that he/she has  been declared eligible in all respects for the post . The eligibility of the candidate will be 
determined as per the eligibility  criteria mentioned in the advertisement  as well as according  to the 
provisions of the Recruitment Regulations of the concerned post. 
2. If at any stage of recruitment process, it is found that the candidate is not fulfilling any  of the 
eligibility conditions, ESI Corporation reserves the right to reject/cancel the  
candidature/selection/appointment of the  said candidate . 
3. The candidates are being called for interview on the basis of the information furnished by them in the 
application form. 
4. Before coming at Interview Venue on the scheduled date and  time as mentioned  above, it is in the  
interest of the candidates to satisfy themselves that they are fulfilling all the eligibility conditions 
as mentioned in the advertisement uploaded on the website of ESI Corporation  (www.esic.gov.in) for 
the above mentioned post. 
5. You are required  to produce the following  documents, in original along with atleast one  set of self attested  
photocopies (with date) :- 
a) Photograph to be pasted on biodata form to be filled at the time of interview. 
b) Matriculation/ 10th Standard or equivalent certificate indicating date of birth, or mark sheet  of Matriculation/10th 
Standard or equivalent issued by Central/State Board indicating Date of Birth in support of their claim of age. 
Where date of birth  is not available  in certificate/mark sheets, issued  by concerned Educational  Boards, School 
leaving certificate indicating Date of Birth will be considered (in case  of Tamil Nadu & Kerala). No other documents 
shall be accepted as proof of date of birth. Candidates belonging to reserved categories i.e. 
SC/ST/OBC/EWS are required  to bring the caste certificate/EWS certificate issued by the competent 
authority in the format prescribed by Govt. of India. The OBC certificate should be issued in 
the last one year with certificate regarding creamy layer. 
c) Copy of PwD certificate showing type and percentage of disability issued by competent authority. 
Roll No.  
Category  
Sub-Category  
 
 
d) Diploma/Degree/Post Graduate Degree/Ph.D. degree certificates, mark sheets of the examinations 
passed along with the attempt certificate. 
e) The Medical qualifications possessed by the candidates  should have the recognition of the NMC. The 
proof thereof may be attached. Candidates possessed foreign Medical Degree should produce certificate 
of passing Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) conducted by National Board of 
Examination 
f) Experience Certificates/Documents in support of experience claimed should be duly signed and stamped 
by Head of Institution/ Head of Department, clearly indicating the period with date, month & year of 
employment and the nature of work performed. Experience will be reckoned upto the last date of receipt 
of applications i.e. 27.07.2026. 
g) Candidates employed on regular/permanent basis will have to bring the No Objection Certificate 
(N.O.C.) from their employer. 
h) Copies of publications/articles/research papers, if any. 
 
6. In so far as Post -Graduation Medical qualifications  awarded by Indian Universities are concerned, they 
should also find a place in the Schedules to Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, as amended from time 
to time. The proof thereof may be attached. 
7. Holders of specialty Board of USA qualifications should complete the entire requirements of the Board 
concerned. 
8. Completion of  compulsory Rotating Internship Certificate, Registration Certificate, an  official document 
showing name of  College / Institution from where Degree /  Diploma has been  done and official document 
showing name of the University and College from where teaching experience  has been attained is to be 
furnished. 
9. The teaching experience should be recognized by  the NMC/Dental Council of  India or the statutory body 
concerned with the system  of medicine  as valid  teaching experience for teaching  posts and certificate 
thereof or any other valid proof in  support thereof should be submitted. Teaching experience in any other 
post like the post of  General Duty Medical Officer /  Medical Officer shall not be  considered for eligibility 
purpose for recruitment to the teaching posts. 
10. In the case of qualifications  in Super -Specialties (M.Ch./ D.M.) except in the case of holders  of 
D.M./M.Ch. of five years’ duration, the holders should have obtained M.D. (General Medicine) or M.S. 
(General surgery) or an equivalent qualification as prescribed by the said council  in its recommendations 
on post graduate medical examination. 
11. In the case of holder  of D.M./ M.Ch.  qualification of five years’ duration,  the period  of Senior  Post 
Graduate residency rendered in the last part of the said D.M./ M.Ch. shall be counted towards require me nt 
of experience. 
12. No TA  will be paid  for the above purpose, nevertheless, out-station SC/ST candidates who are 
unemployed and are not in receipt  of any kind of stipend/emoluments  etc., will be reimbursed  actual 
traveling expenses limited to 2 nd Class Mail/Express Rail fare both ways by the shortest route subject to 
production of the original tickets. SC/ST candidates who are not permitted to appear in the interview for 
any reason will not be entitled to such reimbursement. 
13. Candidates are requested to bring this letter with them at the time of interview. 
14. Please note that no request for change in the date, time and venue will be entertained. 
15. Your candidature is provisional subject to fulfilling of the eligibility criteria up to the satisfaction of the 
Appointing Authority. 
16. The mere fact that you have been called by ESI Corporation does not in any way assure that you will be 
selected. 
17. The candidates have the option of Hindi or English language for the interview.
